'''Elspeth Mecandes''' is a [[Cairhien]]in noblewoman.

==History==
She is the daughter of Lord [[Barris Mecandes|Barris]] and Lady [[Holleen Mecandes]], the latter of whom is the head of the largest [[Darkfriend]] cell in Cairhien. She is also the niece of [[Cabriana Mecandes]], an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]], and thus serves as part of the Ajah's [[eyes-and-ears]] network.

Lady Elspeth vanishes during the period when [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron]] is appointed [[Steward of the Dragon]] in Cairhien. She was later freed, and learned of her mother's true allegiances to the [[Shadow]].<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
